Intro: Do you know…what has changed? The times are different. You are condemning…innocents…to death. That is…if they are lucky. Does it…hmm… matter to you?
They cry…you know? I hear them….always. The one's unlucky enough to be kept alive. They beg of me…hmm…to end their suffering. Sometimes…I even do.
They thank me…hmm…in tears of joy. The lord of this city…does not enjoy my meddling. A conqueror….hmm…she believes to be. Fun…hmm…to test.
I…like you. You know…what it means…to live. How to…hmm…control. Good. I wish to see…one last time…if you deserve to conquer.
Success: This…hmm…is satisfying enough. Listen here. The end is near. We are waiting. Never abandon…your resolve.
Fail: ...quick to send others to death…yet blind of the end of times. We are waiting…hmm…and we shall remember your failures.
